title: ChemInform Abstract: Hydrothermal Synthesis, Structure Characterization and Catalytic Property of a Zigzag Chain Structural Cluster Compound Built on the Novel Tetra‐Capped and Centered By Ni<sup>II</sup>.
abstract: AbstractThe novel Mo/W mixed Keggin derivative (IV) is characterized by powder and single crystal XRD, XPS, IR spectroscopy, and magnetic susceptibility measurements.
